messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Attached is our draft non-binding term sheet reflecting the commercial heads we discussed: £4.5m upfront, 6% running royalty (our opening position), £2m and £3m milestones, exclusive in-field licence with China carved out of the territory, and a 45-day exclusivity period. Subject to contract throughout.

Look forward to your comments.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Tamarisk — draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Thanks. Northstar is broadly comfortable but the royalty rate is the headline issue — 6% is well above where they can make the cell economics work. They'll be pushing hard towards 4–4.5%. We'd also want the liability cap framed at trailing fees, and more time on the commercialisation longstop. Otherwise the shape is right.

We're content to proceed within the 45-day exclusivity.

Regards,
Oliver Jennings
Partner | Birchall Stone LLP
